sql: SELECT T2.company_name, SUM(CASE WHEN T1.remote_us = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_remote_us_data_listings FROM fct_posting AS T1 INNER JOIN dim_company AS T2 ON T1.company_key = T2.company_key WHERE T1.family = 'data' AND T1.is_open = TRUE GROUP BY T2.company_name HAVING SUM(T1.postings_on_board_latest) > 1000
